name: tnt-explode
comment: WP-2.4. Two EntityItems (ids 0, 1) near a TNT block at (0, 61, 0) on the stone platform; a second TNT at (-1, 61, 0). A lit redstone torch (76) set at (1, 61, 0) at t = 0 notifies its neighbours (BlockRedstoneTorch.onBlockAdded) and BlockTNT.onNeighborBlockChange primes the first TNT: EntityTNTPrimed(world, 0.5, 61.5, 0.5) (id 2, one Math.random() kick, fuse 80, EntityTNTPrimed.java:14-25). It falls and slides, its fuse runs down without super.onUpdate (ticksExisted stays 0), and at t = 80 it dies and explodes (createExplosion size 4 with the TNT itself in the entity pass). The explosion destroys the second TNT block, which primes with a World.rand fuse (BlockTNT.onBlockDestroyedByExplosion) and explodes later; the items are knocked back or destroyed. rng_state and entity_state every tick, block_box of the area every 10 ticks.
